description: This file defines the OpenIDConnectClient class in the OrangeHRM system, extending a third-party OpenID Connect client class and providing methods for redirect handling and session key management specific to OrangeHRM's OpenID authentication plugin.

classes.name: OpenIDConnectClient
classes.description: Extends a third-party OpenID Connect client to include specific methods for handling OAuth redirect URL generation and session attribute management within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Sets the generated authentication URL for redirects.

methods.name: getGeneratedAuthUrl
methods.description: Returns the last generated authentication URL.

methods.name: commitSession
methods.description: Placeholder method for committing session; intentionally empty.

methods.name: setSessionKey
methods.description: Stores a session attribute for the authenticated user.

methods.name: getSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute for the authenticated user.

methods.name: unsetSessionKey
methods.description: Removes a session attribute for the authenticated user.
